params.name: size
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: skip_count
params.description: Whether to skip counting the total number of items.

params.name: types
params.description: The types of the users to filter on.

params.name: roles
params.description: The roles of the users to filter on.

params.name: states
params.description:
The states of the users to filter on. Is one of:
  • `active`: The user can perform all actions in the Fordefi platform.
  • `onboarding_pending_code_generation`: The user has been approved but still needs to generate a code for the user.
  • `onboarding_pending_activation`: The user has been generated a code but still needs to activate the account with it.
  • `deleted`: The user has been deleted.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: `True` to include deleted users in the response, `False` otherwise.

params.name: user_ids
params.description: The unique identifiers of the users.

params.name: external_ids
params.description: The IDs that you assign to the end user.

params.name: group_ids
params.description: The unique identifiers of the user groups.

params.name: group_ids__not
params.description: The unique identifiers of the user groups to exclude.

params.name: states_on_groups
params.description:
The states of the user groups to filter group_ids on. Is one of:
  • `active`: The user group is active.
  • `pending_addition`: The user is pending to be added to the group.
  • `pending_removal`: The user is pending to be removed from the group.

items.docs: Get a list of users in the organization.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the user to retrieve.

items.docs: Gets the user that corresponds to the given ID.
